### Health Analytics with R · Module 07: Geospatial & Spatial Epidemiology
***
**Learning objectives**
- Implement circular spatial scan statistic (Kulldorff, 1997)
- Detect significant disease clusters with Monte Carlo permutation inference
- Apply elliptical scan for anisotropic clusters
- Evaluate cluster detection performance (sensitivity, specificity, PPV)
- Visualise detected clusters with uncertainty bounds
- Compare spatial scan vs LISA for cluster detection

**Estimated time:** 3 hours | **Level:** Advanced  
**Libraries:** `sf`, `spdep`, `ggplot2`, `dplyr`

## 1. Setup — With Planted Clusters

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(patchwork)

set.seed(42)
out_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod07")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)

spatial_smooth <- function(values, row_idx, col_idx, nrow, ncol, sigma = 2) {
  grid <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow, ncol = ncol)
  for (i in seq_along(values)) grid[row_idx[i], col_idx[i]] <- values[i]
  k <- ceiling(3 * sigma)
  xs <- (-k):k
  kern <- outer(dnorm(xs, sd = sigma), dnorm(xs, sd = sigma))
  kern <- kern / sum(kern)
  pad <- k
  gp <- matrix(0, nrow + 2 * pad, ncol + 2 * pad)
  gp[(pad + 1):(pad + nrow), (pad + 1):(pad + ncol)] <- grid
  out <- matrix(0, nrow, ncol)
  for (r in seq_len(nrow)) for (c in seq_len(ncol)) {
    out[r, c] <- sum(gp[r:(r + 2 * k), c:(c + 2 * k)] * kern)
  }
  mapply(function(r, c) out[r, c], row_idx, col_idx)
}

NROW <- 10; NCOL <- 20; N <- NROW * NCOL
row_idx <- rep(seq_len(NROW), each = NCOL)
col_idx <- rep(seq_len(NCOL), times = NROW)
lon <- -120 + (col_idx - 1) * 2.5 + rnorm(N, 0, 0.3)
lat <- 28 + (row_idx - 1) * 2.0 + rnorm(N, 0, 0.2)
pct_poverty <- 10 + 8 * rbeta(N, 2, 5) + 3 * sin(lon / 20)
pm25 <- 8 + 4 * rgamma(N, 2, 1)
population <- as.integer(rlnorm(N, 10.5, 1.0))
spatial_risk <- spatial_smooth(rnorm(N), row_idx, col_idx, NROW, NCOL)
cvd_rate <- (180 + 1.2 * pct_poverty + 0.5 * pm25 + 15 * spatial_risk + rnorm(N, 0, 12))
# Plant two known clusters
cluster1_mask <- (lon > -105) & (lon < -95) & (lat > 30) & (lat < 36)
cluster2_mask <- (lon > -85) & (lon < -75) & (lat > 38) & (lat < 44)
cvd_rate[cluster1_mask] <- cvd_rate[cluster1_mask] + 35
cvd_rate[cluster2_mask] <- cvd_rate[cluster2_mask] + 25
expected <- (cvd_rate / 100000) * population * 5
observed <- rpois(N, expected)
smr <- observed / pmax(expected, 1)

df <- tibble(
  county_id = sprintf("C%03d", seq_len(N) - 1),
  lon, lat, row = row_idx, col = col_idx,
  pct_poverty, pm25, population, cvd_rate, observed, expected, smr,
  true_cluster1 = cluster1_mask, true_cluster2 = cluster2_mask
)
geoms <- Map(function(lo, la) {
  st_polygon(list(matrix(
    c(lo - 1.25, la - 1, lo + 1.25, la - 1, lo + 1.25, la + 1,
      lo - 1.25, la + 1, lo - 1.25, la - 1), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE
  )))
}, df$lon, df$lat)
gdf <- st_sf(df, geometry = st_sfc(geoms, crs = 4326))
cat(sprintf("N=%d | Cluster1: %d counties | Cluster2: %d counties\n",
            N, sum(cluster1_mask), sum(cluster2_mask)))
```

## 2. Kulldorff Spatial Scan Statistic

The **spatial scan statistic** tests whether the number of cases within a circular window Z is higher than expected:

```
LLR(Z) = log[ (O_Z/E_Z)^O_Z * ((O-O_Z)/(E-E_Z))^(O-O_Z) ]
```

Where:
- O_Z, E_Z = observed and expected cases inside window Z
- O, E = total observed and expected
- The window that maximises LLR is the **most likely cluster**
- Significance is assessed via Monte Carlo permutation (randomise cases under H₀)

This is equivalent to the Poisson spatial scan statistic implemented in SaTScan software.

```{r}
scan_statistic_poisson <- function(df_in, max_pop_fraction = 0.5, n_perm = 199, seed = 42) {
  coords  <- cbind(df_in$lon, df_in$lat)
  O_total <- sum(df_in$observed)
  E_total <- sum(df_in$expected)
  n       <- nrow(df_in)
  max_pop <- sum(df_in$population) * max_pop_fraction
  dmat    <- as.matrix(dist(coords))

  llr_poisson <- function(O_z, E_z) {
    if (O_z == 0 || E_z == 0 || O_z <= E_z) return(0)
    O_out <- O_total - O_z
    E_out <- E_total - E_z
    if (O_out <= 0 || E_out <= 0 || O_out <= E_out) return(0)
    max(0, O_z * log(O_z / E_z) + O_out * log(O_out / E_out))
  }

  best_llr <- 0; best_center <- 1; best_radius <- 0; best_inside <- integer(0)

  for (ci in seq_len(n)) {
    ord <- order(dmat[ci, ])
    O_z <- 0; E_z <- 0; pop_z <- 0
    for (k in 2:n) {
      j <- ord[k]
      pop_z <- pop_z + df_in$population[j]
      if (pop_z > max_pop) break
      O_z <- O_z + df_in$observed[j]
      E_z <- E_z + df_in$expected[j]
      llr <- llr_poisson(O_z, E_z)
      if (llr > best_llr) {
        best_llr <- llr
        best_center <- ci
        best_radius <- dmat[ci, j]
        best_inside <- ord[2:k]
      }
    }
  }

  set.seed(seed)
  mc_llrs <- numeric(n_perm)
  E_arr <- df_in$expected
  p_mult <- E_arr / E_total
  for (b in seq_len(n_perm)) {
    O_perm <- as.numeric(rmultinom(1, O_total, p_mult))
    best_b <- 0
    for (ci in seq_len(n)) {
      ord <- order(dmat[ci, ])
      Oz <- 0; Ez <- 0; popz <- 0
      for (k in 2:n) {
        j <- ord[k]
        popz <- popz + df_in$population[j]
        if (popz > max_pop) break
        Oz <- Oz + O_perm[j]
        Ez <- Ez + E_arr[j]
        l <- llr_poisson(Oz, Ez)
        if (l > best_b) best_b <- l
      }
    }
    mc_llrs[b] <- best_b
  }

  list(
    best_llr = best_llr, best_center = best_center,
    best_radius = best_radius, best_inside = best_inside,
    p_value = mean(mc_llrs >= best_llr), mc_llrs = mc_llrs
  )
}

cat("Running spatial scan statistic (may take 1-2 minutes)...\n")
scan_res <- scan_statistic_poisson(df, max_pop_fraction = 0.40, n_perm = 199)
cat(sprintf(
  "Primary cluster: centre=%s | radius=%.2f° | n=%d counties | LLR=%.2f | p=%.4f\n",
  df$county_id[scan_res$best_center], scan_res$best_radius,
  length(scan_res$best_inside), scan_res$best_llr, scan_res$p_value
))
```

```{r}
# Cluster map
gdf$in_cluster1 <- seq_len(N) %in% scan_res$best_inside
smr_in  <- mean(gdf$smr[gdf$in_cluster1])
smr_out <- mean(gdf$smr[!gdf$in_cluster1])

gdf$true_lab <- case_when(
  gdf$true_cluster1 ~ "Cluster1",
  gdf$true_cluster2 ~ "Cluster2",
  TRUE              ~ "None"
)

p_true <- ggplot(gdf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = true_lab), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Cluster1 = "#DC2626", Cluster2 = "#2563EB", None = "#E0E0E0")) +
  labs(title = "TRUE clusters (planted)\nRed=Cluster1 (+35/100k) | Blue=Cluster2 (+25/100k)",
       fill = NULL, x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude")

cx <- df$lon[scan_res$best_center]
cy <- df$lat[scan_res$best_center]
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
circ <- st_buffer(st_sfc(st_point(c(cx, cy)), crs = 4326), dist = scan_res$best_radius)

p_det <- ggplot(gdf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = in_cluster1), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_sf(data = circ, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#DC2626", "FALSE" = "#E0E0E0"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf(
      "DETECTED cluster (scan statistic)\nLLR=%.2f, p=%.3f  SMR inside=%.3f vs outside=%.3f",
      scan_res$best_llr, scan_res$p_value, smr_in, smr_out
    ),
    x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude"
  )

p_scan <- p_true | p_det
print(p_scan)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "scan_cluster_map.png"), p_scan, width = 16, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

## 3. Cluster Detection Performance

```{r}
detected <- gdf$in_cluster1
true_any <- gdf$true_cluster1 | gdf$true_cluster2

tp <- sum(detected & true_any)
fp <- sum(detected & !true_any)
fn <- sum(!detected & true_any)
tn <- sum(!detected & !true_any)

sensitivity <- if ((tp + fn) > 0) tp / (tp + fn) else 0
specificity <- if ((tn + fp) > 0) tn / (tn + fp) else 0
ppv         <- if ((tp + fp) > 0) tp / (tp + fp) else 0
npv         <- if ((tn + fn) > 0) tn / (tn + fn) else 0

cat("Cluster Detection Performance:\n")
cat(sprintf("  True positives  : %d\n", tp))
cat(sprintf("  False positives : %d\n", fp))
cat(sprintf("  False negatives : %d (true cluster counties missed)\n", fn))
cat(sprintf("  True negatives  : %d\n", tn))
cat(sprintf("  Sensitivity     : %.3f\n", sensitivity))
cat(sprintf("  Specificity     : %.3f\n", specificity))
cat(sprintf("  PPV             : %.3f\n", ppv))
cat(sprintf("  NPV             : %.3f\n", npv))

obs_in  <- sum(df$observed[detected]);  exp_in  <- sum(df$expected[detected])
obs_out <- sum(df$observed[!detected]); exp_out <- sum(df$expected[!detected])
rr <- (obs_in / exp_in) / (obs_out / exp_out)
cat(sprintf("\nRelative risk (inside vs outside detected cluster): %.3f\n", rr))
cat(sprintf("Expected RR from planted effect: ~%.2f to ~%.2f\n", 1 + 35 / 180, 1 + 25 / 180))
```

## 4. Permutation Distribution & Inference

```{r}
p_mc <- ggplot(tibble(llr = scan_res$mc_llrs), aes(llr)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#AEC6CF", colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = scan_res$best_llr, colour = "#DC2626", linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Spatial scan LLR", y = "Count",
    title = sprintf("Monte Carlo Null Distribution (B=199) p=%.4f", scan_res$p_value)
  )

cluster_sizes <- seq(5, 50, by = 5)
llrs_by_size <- sapply(cluster_sizes, function(max_in) {
  subset <- df[seq_len(max_in), ]
  O_z <- sum(subset$observed); E_z <- sum(subset$expected)
  O_out <- sum(df$observed) - O_z; E_out <- sum(df$expected) - E_z
  if (O_z > 0 && E_z > 0 && O_z > E_z && O_out > 0 && E_out > 0 && O_out > E_out) {
    max(0, O_z * log(O_z / E_z) + O_out * log(O_out / E_out))
  } else 0
})

p_size <- ggplot(tibble(size = cluster_sizes, llr = llrs_by_size), aes(size, llr)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#2563EB", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(colour = "#2563EB", size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Window size (# counties)", y = "LLR", title = "LLR by Scanning Window Size")

p_inf <- p_mc | p_size
print(p_inf)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "scan_inference.png"), p_inf, width = 14, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

## 5. LISA vs Scan Statistic Comparison

```{r}
nb <- vector("list", N)
for (i in seq_len(N)) {
  nbrs <- which(pmax(abs(df$row - df$row[i]), abs(df$col - df$col[i])) <= 1)
  nb[[i]] <- setdiff(nbrs, i)
}
class(nb) <- "nb"
attr(nb, "region.id") <- as.character(seq_len(N))
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

lisa <- localmoran(df$cvd_rate, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
z_std <- as.numeric(scale(df$cvd_rate))
z_lag <- lag.listw(lw, z_std, zero.policy = TRUE)
quad <- ifelse(z_std > 0 & z_lag > 0, "HH",
               ifelse(z_std < 0 & z_lag < 0, "LL", "Other"))
gdf$lisa_hh <- (lisa[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"] < 0.05) & (quad == "HH")

# Getis-Ord G* for comparison
lw_g <- nb2listw(include.self(nb), style = "B", zero.policy = TRUE)
gs <- as.numeric(localG(df$cvd_rate, lw_g, zero.policy = TRUE))
gdf$gstar_hot <- gs > 1.96

p_lisa <- ggplot(gdf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = lisa_hh), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#DC2626", "FALSE" = "#E0E0E0"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("LISA (HH, p<0.05)\n%d flagged | %d true positives captured",
                    sum(gdf$lisa_hh), sum(gdf$lisa_hh & true_any)),
    x = "Lon", y = "Lat"
  )
p_sc <- ggplot(gdf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = in_cluster1), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#DC2626", "FALSE" = "#E0E0E0"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Scan Statistic\n%d flagged | %d true positives captured",
                    sum(gdf$in_cluster1), sum(gdf$in_cluster1 & true_any)),
    x = "Lon", y = "Lat"
  )

p_cmp <- (p_lisa | p_sc) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Cluster Detection: LISA vs Spatial Scan Statistic")
print(p_cmp)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "lisa_vs_scan.png"), p_cmp, width = 14, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

## 6. Knowledge Check
1. The scan statistic detects a cluster with p=0.03 (200 permutations). How precise is this p-value, and what would you report?
2. Your detected cluster has PPV=0.65. In a public health context, what does this mean for resource allocation decisions?
3. The maximum window size is set to 50% of population. Why is there an upper bound, and what is the trade-off?
4. LISA detects 18 HH counties but the scan statistic finds a different 15-county cluster. Why might they differ?
5. Implement a secondary cluster search: after removing the primary cluster, re-run the scan to find the next most likely cluster.

```{r}
# Exercise 5 — secondary cluster detection
df_secondary <- df %>% filter(!gdf$in_cluster1) %>% mutate(.row = row_number())
cat(sprintf("Searching for secondary cluster in %d remaining counties...\n",
            nrow(df_secondary)))
scan_sec <- scan_statistic_poisson(df_secondary, max_pop_fraction = 0.40, n_perm = 99, seed = 99)
sec_center_county <- df_secondary$county_id[scan_sec$best_center]
sec_n <- length(scan_sec$best_inside)
cat(sprintf("Secondary cluster: centre=%s | n=%d counties | LLR=%.2f | p=%.3f\n",
            sec_center_county, sec_n, scan_sec$best_llr, scan_sec$p_value))
if (scan_sec$p_value < 0.05) {
  cat("Secondary cluster is statistically significant!\n")
  inside_sec <- scan_sec$best_inside
  true_cl2_idx <- which(df_secondary$true_cluster2)
  overlap <- length(intersect(true_cl2_idx, inside_sec))
  cat(sprintf("Overlap with true cluster 2: %d/%d counties\n",
              overlap, sum(df_secondary$true_cluster2)))
} else {
  cat("No significant secondary cluster found.\n")
}
```
